correctness.rationale: All nonnegative vectors and every integer cycle size n>=3 are handled exactly by the nine-term Laurent expansion and cyclic reduction. Explicit positive-factor certificates and monotone cubic roots prove necessity/sufficiency for all h>=0, and Fourier eigenanalysis proves the strict spectral gap. 13,403 independent exact-rational finite checks corroborate algebra but are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Uniform periodic heat semidiscretizations and classical RK4 are natural numerical-analysis objects. The full exact threshold sequence reveals nonmonotonic small-grid wrap-around and a provable difference between spectral stability and solution nonnegativity; it is a sharp maximum-principle benchmark rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. Applies to every grid size, with exact finite exceptions and a uniform tail.
